title: Spyglass: Now Fully Launched!
summary: We're excited to announce Spyglass is now fully available, providing robust new capabilities to help you gain clearer insights and make informed decisions.

title: Greater Control Over Your Files
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your content with new file management capabilities, empowering you to effortlessly upload, organize, and customize how your files are displayed within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to see what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable, all while updating their look to match our modern interface.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with significant improvements that make collaborating on your documents smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Discovery
summary: Effortlessly share and collaborate on your ideas and quests with others, enhancing teamwork and discovery.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko in a wider array of languages, making our powerful platform accessible and intuitive for everyone, everywhere.

title: Noeko is Going Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with full control and transparency over its future development.

title: Dynamic Filters for Your Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your knowledge map into a highly personalized and efficient workflow starter with powerful new filtering capabilities by tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Powerful Search & Custom Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock a new level of productivity with enhanced search filters, dynamic sorting options, and the ability to instantly save your perfectly tailored knowledge collections for quick access.

title: Interactive Note Connections
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts with versatile and interactive displays for connected content, making your notes truly reflect your thinking.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting & Paid Plans
summary: Get ready to take full control of your Noeko experience with new self-hosting options and flexible paid plans tailored to your team's needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: We are introducing a collection of vibrant new themes and refining our existing designs to offer a more personalized and visually appealing experience for every user.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience as we ensure our time-based greetings precisely reflect the current time of day, every time you log in.

title: Quickly Organize Tagged Content
summary: Gain greater control over your tagged content by directly removing items and performing other essential actions, all from a single, convenient view.

title: Unlock New Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, such as videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your valuable information.
